issue.mint_text: Royal Canadian Mint · Ottawa (no mintmark on business strikes)

C160.notes: SER NA-CA-001. Reverse beaver on rock · 5 CENTS · maple leaves · CANADA 1939 · photo (George VI obverse not shown). Last peacetime year before WWII — pure nickel still, before the 1942–1945 tombac / steel wartime compositions. Everyday Dominion change: streetcar, corner store, a beaver already iconic on the nickel while Europe marched into war the same calendar year. First Canada flip in the vault (albums hold the cents run). Canada flips now 1.
